$comment: The 28 items of the platform split audit (open-source edition at 1a78e433 vs Ratel Cloud at 2848c52c). status: open = not fixed yet, its parity tests are reported as todo and do not fail the run; fixed = its parity tests gate CI. A fix pull request flips its items to fixed. Temporary: removed with the parity harness at the closeout (RTL-45).

items.title: Fixes has no savings (Cloud #323)
OTel spans, logs and trace summaries are never pruned
The platform's own OpenTelemetry export is never registered
The sidebar's "Analysis updated … ago" line is missing
The guided tour is absent
Settings › API keys has no "Send a trace" quickstart
A turn page has no "run to test" action with FF_EVAL_GATE on
⌘K finds less
Two cross-links are switched off by stale comments
Three OTel tables lack Cloud's autovacuum settings
The Tasks page's freshness ignores score_tasks
The Site Copilot seed is not the same history as Cloud's
"Last project" is never remembered
"New project" skips onboarding, so the project gets no API key
The catalog's "Register tools with the SDK" snippet no longer connects to the platform
A drafted fix whose replay came out worse is ranked last only if it is a rewrite
Any source id ending in -import counts as an import
The rail highlights the wrong item, or none
Two redirects go elsewhere
Project pages answer 404 without a database
Project home builds its ingest address from a variable this edition never documents
The capture nudge shows a diff against a snippet this edition no longer hands out
Rewrites vanish from Fixes if the adoption read fails
Two routes match the project id case-sensitively
Root metadata is reduced
Two drain heartbeat keys lost their Cloud names
Five jobs lost their project log context
The playground heading says "Test a search"
